document.title: EXDIR Update - Islamic Extremist Terrorist Threat
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), The Central Intelligence Agency 9/11 File: Hundreds of Secret Agency Documents on Osama Bin Laden Declassified
document.note: Highlighted for its budget warning: CT supplemental funding still at NSC-OMB level, and due to budgetary constraints CTC/UBL will move from an offensive to a defensive posture.

organizations.name: CIA Counterterrorist Center/UBL Station
organizations.notes: The slide text is garbled by OCR. It appears to say that, because of budget constraints, 'CTC/UBL will move . . . to defensive posture'. The wording is partly inferred.

events.description: The briefing slide says budget constraints would force CTC/UBL to move to a defensive posture, and it notes a need for a forward-moving CT supplemental. The OCR is heavily garbled, so the details are uncertain.

relationships.detail: The CTC/UBL unit is a component of CIA, as the document's CIA origin and its budget discussion imply. The OCR text never states this directly.

key_claims: The briefing slide says a counterterrorism supplemental budget request is pending at the NSC/OMB level, and the text is partly garbled.
The slide says the supplemental needs to be moved forward soon because of an expected congressional recess for conventions and campaigning in the elections.
The slide appears to say that, because of budget constraints, CTC/UBL will move to a defensive posture; this reading is uncertain because of the OCR damage.
The document contains a slide titled 'Uzbek Initiative', but no detail is legible.
